resources.string: Print or display a regular grid / checkerboard target. Fill the frame with the grid pattern. Hold the phone steady and parallel to the target. Used for lens-distortion and structure-tensor calibration.

Capture a periodic pattern: stripes, gratings, fence, regular tiling. Keep the pattern aligned to one image axis (horizontal or vertical). Used for autocorrelation-period recovery and weak-signal tests.
Capture a scene with mirror symmetry about a vertical or horizontal axis. Center the symmetry axis in the frame. Used for mirror-correlation and higher-order coherence tests.

Reduce ambient light or shoot a dark scene with a small bright source. The phone will run at the camera\'s natural high-ISO. Used to characterise the ISO 800-3200 noise profile and weak-signal recovery predicates.

Two bursts at orthogonal phone orientations. (1) Aim at a glossy / reflective / glass surface, hold landscape, tap CAPTURE. (2) After the burst, ROTATE phone 90 deg clockwise (portrait), tap CAPTURE again. EXPORT bundles both bursts in one .aurex-session zip with axisLabel per frame. Unblocks has_polarization_signal.
